TUINBOOKS BASKET FIX — MAIN (64)
=================================

This package is for TUINBOOKS-main (64) only.

EASIEST METHOD
1. Open APPLY-TUINBOOKS-BASKET-FIX-main64.html in Edge/Chrome.
2. Choose the untouched /app/app.js from TUINBOOKS-main (64).
3. Click "Apply fix and download app.js".
4. The tool validates every diff hunk. If anything differs it stops without producing a file.
5. Upload ONLY the generated app.js over /app/app.js.
6. Hard refresh and test Basket open/close, then Drag Mode multi-select.

BASKET-FIX-main64.diff is included for review.
No index.html, CSS, service worker, SQL, or other file is changed.
